rule: primary NFL-flagged non-vacant non-draft-class records whose identity differs from the retail record at the same index; years pro was written as nflverse years_exp (rookie 0); the game stores rookie = 1

basis_codes.26n: nflverse roster_2026.csv, name and birth date; years_pro == years_exp
basis_codes.25n: nflverse roster_2025.csv, name and birth date; years_pro == years_exp(2025) + 1
basis_codes.26f: nflverse roster_2026.csv, birth date and club or surname (Jr./II name variant); years_pro == years_exp
basis_codes.25f: nflverse roster_2025.csv, birth date and surname; years_pro == years_exp(2025) + 1
basis_codes.old: an earlier nflverse annual roster's entry_year; years_pro == 2026 - entry_year
